title: Matching labeling sum as an edge assignment sum
statement: Let $q,k,n$ be nonnegative integers and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$. Form the complete $q$-partite graph with $k$ vertices in each part. Sum, over every perfect matching in this graph and every labeling of its vertices by $[n]$ that assigns equal labels to the endpoints of each matched edge, the product over the parts of the absolute value of the Fourier coefficient of $f$ indexed by the set of labels in that part. This sum equals the sum over every perfect matching and every assignment of labels in $[n]$ to its edges of the product over the parts of the absolute value of the Fourier coefficient indexed by the set of labels assigned to edges incident with that part.
